tagline: A ranged toolbox that only gets harder to kill as the beskar piles up

featuredCards.title: BESKAR ARMOR
featuredCards.caption: Once it hits the discard pile it never stops working — every later defence counts it. Blocking gets better the longer you fight him.

featuredCards.title: QUICK DRAW
featuredCards.caption: A cheap shot that hands back the action it cost. It is the glue between the grabs and the punishes.

featuredCards.title: CABLE SHOT
featuredCards.caption: Yanks a fighter into his lap and hurts them on arrival. Once they are close, the whole toolbox has a target.

featuredCards.title: I CAN BRING YOU IN WARM...
featuredCards.caption: Win with it and the deck stops being random — search out the exact tool the fight is asking for.
